Market today: Oil prices are falling on demand worries, but Middle East tensions are a wildcard. This isn't directly hitting your tech book, but broad market sentiment can still impact it.

Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -40.95% - it's leveraged and decaying, and your stop is way off. SPAL is also a SELL at -36.54% for similar reasons. CRWD, QQQ, SPY, SMH, and QQQI look fine for now.

Watch: Keep an eye on SMCI's 'ACCUMULATE' status and its tight entry/stop range.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged, decaying positions and respecting your stops.
plays: SOXL: Trim/Exit - leveraged decay is a killer, especially on margin. Consider exiting or drastically cutting size.
SPAL: Trim/Exit - same as SOXL, high decay risk on margin. Consider exiting or drastically cutting size.
SMCI: Consider Accumulate - entry 39.62-39.58, stop 39.29. High conviction setup.
